user_saw: Notices above the chat composer used different background and border colors depending on the notice type.
summary: The fix gives composer notices a shared neutral background and border while retaining status colors on icons or text.
reasoning: The original composer redesign explicitly tinted the status lane by tone, and the September footer refactor carried those rules forward. Compaction indicators and alert callouts had their own styles, and the fix bundle describes a visual consistency change without reporting a rendering or usability failure.
